binding.description: Broker-native locator applied to the deal at publish time (belphegor/plan_engine/deal_binding.py apply_publish_binding) — e.g. account_id, symbol.

broker_instrument.description: BF trading params of the resolved instrument (initial margin, tradable/longable/shortable, lot size, price_step, price_type, ...) — see InstrumentInfo.to_broker_instrument_dict(). With `account_id` in the request the values are the account's own.

price_type.description: Which order/trigger prices the instrument allows (Finam AssetParams.price_type): POSITIVE = strictly > 0; NON_NEGATIVE = >= 0; ANY = negative prices allowed (e.g. some futures); UNKNOWN = the broker did not say. Optional — absent means UNKNOWN.

title: payload: broker.instrument_resolved
description: Response to broker.resolve_instrument (deal-instrument pre-flight resolution). Deliberately permissive (additionalProperties: true throughout) — both objects are BF-owned shapes; this is a PATCH-level description of existing wire behavior, not a new constraint on it.
